We are very happy to see that Garten of Banban has gained a lot of interest. If you would to stay up to the date with this series or any future updates then check out our social media links:

[b]Twitter[/b] (For all the news and updates):

[b]Youtube[/b] (For all the trailers and potentially development/behind the scenes videos or devlogs):
[h3][b][url=https://www.youtube.com/@EuphoricBrothers]https://www.youtube.com/@EuphoricBrothers[/url][/b][/h3]

[b]Tiktok[/b] (For short videos about our games):
[h3][b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@euphoricbros]https://www.tiktok.com/@euphoricbros[/url][/b][/h3]

[b]If you enjoyed Garten of Banban, then also check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2262770/Garten_of_Banban_2/]Garten of Banban 2[/url] and add it to your wishlist![/b]

That's it, thanks again for being here!
